components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion action for checking a brand.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; color: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); background: oklch(0.31 0.085 165); font: 900 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.07 165); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.68 0.16 38); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary navigation action beside the main CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 20px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.035 155); border-radius: 999px; color: oklch(0.31 0.085 165); background: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); font: 900 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(0.31 0.085 165); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.68 0.16 38); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Proof Chip
components.description: Rounded proof point for trust statements.
components.css: .ds-proof-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.035 155); border-radius: 999px; color: oklch(0.22 0.07 165); background: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); font: 900 1rem/1.2 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.html:
Busca e classificacao

Verificamos marcas semelhantes e indicios da classe adequada.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.035 155); border-radius: 34px; color: oklch(0.18 0.035 165); background: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 1.24rem; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 900; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: oklch(0.46 0.035 165); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text field used in the diagnostic form.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.46 0.035 165); font: 800 1rem/1.35 Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 54px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.84 0.035 155); border-radius: 16px; color: oklch(0.18 0.035 165); background: oklch(0.985 0.01 155); font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.31 0.085 165); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.55 0.08 165 / 0.18); }

components.name: Floating Header
components.description: Desktop navigation shell for the brand and primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; justify-content: space-between; max-width: 760px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0.025 155 / 0.85); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.99 0.008 155 / 0.9); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px oklch(0.18 0.035 165 / 0.09); font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); background: oklch(0.31 0.085 165); font-weight: 900; } .ds-header strong { margin-right: auto; color: oklch(0.18 0.035 165); } .ds-header a { padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 999px; color: oklch(0.99 0.008 155); background: oklch(0.22 0.07 165); font-weight: 900; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: The HH Amorim interface should feel like a careful studio for a legal asset: warm enough for entrepreneurs, precise enough for intellectual property, and visually confident enough to avoid the generic legal-office mold. The current system uses a committed teal-green identity, a sunlit yellow field, and a coral action accent to make the page feel active without becoming aggressive.
keyCharacteristics: Large, confident type with short and direct messaging.
Rounded, tactile containers that feel approachable rather than bureaucratic.
Deep green authority balanced by sun and coral accents.
Real imagery and layered cards in the hero, never abstract placeholders.
Form-first conversion, with the diagnostic presented as a calm next step.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Never use pure white or pure black. Every neutral must stay tinted toward the green brand world.

rules.name: The Coral Is A Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is for attention, progress, labels, and numbered moments. Do not turn it into the dominant brand color.

rules.name: The One Family Confidence Rule
rules.body: Stay in one sans family and create hierarchy with weight, size, and spacing. Do not introduce a decorative serif just to appear premium.

rules.name: The Calm Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows must be broad and soft. If a card looks like a dashboard widget, the shadow is too literal.

dos: Do use Studio Green and Deep Registry Green as the authority base.
Do keep the diagnostic form prominent, calm, and friction-light.
Do use real imagery for the hero or equivalent brand surfaces.
Do explain risk with sober language and clear next steps.
Do preserve large rounded surfaces, broad spacing, and asymmetric layout.
donts: Don't make the site look like an escritorio juridico engessado, frio ou excessivamente formal.
Don't make it look like uma pagina de guru de marketing with urgency tricks, exaggerated claims, or infoproduct aesthetics.
Don't make it look like uma landing page generica de SaaS with empty metrics, repeated cards, decorative gradients, or fake dashboards.
Don't promise registro garantido, aprovacao certa, or marca disponivel without prior analysis.
Don't suggest any official relationship with INPI.
Don't use pure black, pure white, side-stripe accent borders, or gradient text.
